editorial:
You follow Ralph Sarchie, a tough New York cop who has seen way too much darkness on the job. When a string of bizarre, violent crimes hits the city, he cannot explain them with normal police work. That is when a renegade priest named Mendoza steps in and tells him something wild: demonic possession might be behind the murders. The two team up for a supernatural fight against evil, and the movie blends gritty cop drama with full-on horror in a way that keeps you on edge.

The acting is solid, especially Eric Bana as the worn-down Sarchie and Edgar Ramirez as the intense priest. The scares come from creepy atmosphere and disturbing scenes rather than cheap jump scares, and the pacing moves fast enough to keep you hooked. Some parts feel a bit familiar if you have seen other possession movies, and the story can get heavy at times. Still, if you enjoy crime thrillers mixed with supernatural horror, this one delivers. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Sarchie and Mendoza perform a dramatic exorcism on a possessed man in a basement. The demon fights back hard, but Sarchie finally embraces his faith and helps complete the ritual, freeing the man. The twist is that the evil was never just one person; it had spread through multiple people across the city. After the exorcism, Sarchie returns to his family, changed and more open to the spiritual side of life, while Mendoza warns him the battle against evil is far from over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers mixed with supernatural horror.
